source.note: Tmax steps 163-200 are extrapolated (log-linear fit to steps 93-162); pooled statistics use measured steps only.

definitions.accepted_fraction: Sum of accepted groups divided by sum of collected groups over all logged steps; not the arithmetic mean of per-step fractions.
definitions.collection_minutes: Arithmetic mean of the exported rollout_collection_minutes field. This is not an estimate of total training cost.
definitions.plot: Faint per-step values and solid trailing arithmetic means: 3 steps for useful rate, 5 for collection time. The first full windows end at steps 2 and 4. Tmax steps 163-200 are extrapolated (log-linear fit to steps 93-162); no confidence bands.
definitions.hardware: The authors confirmed matched hardware and rollout concurrency on 2026-09-17.
definitions.timer_scope: Exact timer boundaries and inclusion of environment-generation time are not specified in the CSV.
